sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Tarkov Shooter - Part 4 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "It's good that you're alive, tasks from Sniper are not easy. Let's wait for a little before the next test. There is going to be a lot more complicated sniper work from now on, so my advice is that you master your bolt-action rifle handling skills some more. Come back when you're ready."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 5 PMC operatives from over 80 meters away while using a bolt-action rifle

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +11,800 EXP
- Jaeger Rep +0.02
- 80,000 Roubles
  - 84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Mosin Rifle AIM Sports Tri-Rail mount
- 1× Mosin Rifle Tacfire pistol grip
- Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle AIM Sports Tri-Rail mount at Jaeger LL2
- Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle Tacfire pistol grip at Jaeger LL2
"Ready? Then let's get to work. Sniper took a big interest in you."
